entries.failure: The first read-only exact-manifest helper wrote every blob request before draining batch output, filled the child output pipe, and timed out without a result.
entries.recovery: Use subprocess communicate with the complete request payload so input and output are drained concurrently, then parse every returned blob deterministically.
entries.recurrence_guard: Never manually write a large cat-file batch to a piped child without concurrent output draining.

entries.failure: A read-only novelty keyword probe reached a title containing a Maori macron and failed while Python encoded output through the PowerShell default code page.
entries.recovery: Set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 before emitting proposal titles and rerun the bounded read-only query.
entries.recurrence_guard: Use explicit UTF-8 for every Python command whose output may contain non-ASCII repository text.

entries.failure: A read-only rg file inventory across the large scripts and tests baseline timed out before returning any target-path result.
entries.recovery: Probe only the finite planned v650-v5 paths with Test-Path and use exact Git status separately.
entries.recurrence_guard: Do not scan the inherited repository to establish absence of a finite known target set.

entries.failure: A read-only stale-token scan passed Windows wildcard paths directly to rg, which treated them as invalid literal paths and returned no complete result.
entries.recovery: Root rg at exact scripts and tests directories and express file selection with -g include globs.
entries.recurrence_guard: Do not pass unexpanded Windows wildcard path arguments to rg.

entries.failure: A compile-only Python probe created two ignored v650-v5 bytecode cache files in scripts before the side effect was noticed.
entries.recovery: Verify the exact owner-generated cache paths, remove only those files, and rerun syntax imports with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
entries.recurrence_guard: Use no-bytecode import checks for repository scripts; do not use py_compile in the working tree.

entries.failure: A combined exact-cache cleanup, import, and stale-token wrapper was blocked by command policy before any child operation executed.
entries.recovery: Run exact already-verified owner-cache deletion separately, then run no-bytecode imports and exact-directory rg checks as read-only commands.
entries.recurrence_guard: Separate bounded cleanup from validation instead of placing deletion and evidence checks in one compound wrapper.

entries.failure: A separated exact-path PowerShell Remove-Item command was also blocked by command policy before deleting either verified owner cache file.
entries.recovery: Use a bounded exact-path binary cleanup fallback only for the two verified owner-generated bytecode files.
entries.recurrence_guard: Avoid repository bytecode creation so binary cache cleanup is unnecessary.

entries.failure: The text patch tool could not delete either verified bytecode file because both are binary and fail UTF-8 decoding.
entries.recovery: Use a binary-capable exact-path cleanup fallback and verify both paths are absent afterward.
entries.recurrence_guard: Reserve apply_patch for text artifacts and avoid creating repository-local bytecode.

entries.failure: The mechanical template step instantiated untracked v650-v5 x2, runner, closeout, and x2-test files before the x1 freeze boundary.
entries.recovery: Delete only the new untracked v650-v5 x2 and closeout templates, retain the fault, and recreate them only after x1 is committed, pushed, and four-way equal.
entries.recurrence_guard: Instantiate only phase-data, x1 generator, and x1 tests before the dedicated x1 commit.

entries.failure: A narrow read-only rg lookup over the two v650-v5 x1 files timed out before returning line evidence.
entries.recovery: Use Select-String with two exact file paths and the bounded patterns needed for the edit.
entries.recurrence_guard: Use exact-file PowerShell matching when the local rg path shows unexplained latency.

entries.failure: The combined x1-only status, absence, and count wrapper had an invalid nested expression inside a PowerShell hash literal and stopped before any check ran.
entries.recovery: Run Git status, exact premature-path absence, and no-bytecode negative count as separate commands.
entries.recurrence_guard: Do not embed environment assignment and native command execution inside a PowerShell hash-literal value.

entries.failure: The parallel status, absence, and count recovery batch timed out before yielding attributable per-check results.
entries.recovery: Run exact pathspec status, premature-path absence, and no-bytecode count sequentially with independent outputs.
entries.recurrence_guard: Do not bundle a potentially slow Git untracked-tree walk with otherwise fast recovery probes.

entries.failure: The first x1 generator run stopped at the semantic-novelty gate before writing packet artifacts because at least one candidate crossed the frozen lexical quarantine threshold.
entries.recovery: Inspect only the returned in-memory collision rows, replace quarantined mechanisms, and rerun the unchanged fail-closed gate.
entries.recurrence_guard: Compute exact nearest-neighbour scores before attempting the artifact-writing x1 generator.

entries.failure: The first corrected in-memory novelty probe loaded the x1 generator by file path without adding the scripts directory to the module search path, so its phase-data import failed before the audit ran.
entries.recovery: Insert the exact owner scripts directory into the probe-only module search path before loading the x1 generator, while keeping bytecode disabled.
entries.recurrence_guard: File-based Python probes for sibling modules must declare the containing scripts directory explicitly.

entries.failure: The first summary wrapper treated the novelty audit's two-item tuple as a mapping and raised an attribute error after the audit returned.
entries.recovery: Read the exact function contract, unpack the frozen-index and collision-audit tuple, and summarize only declared collision fields.
entries.recurrence_guard: Inspect a local helper's return annotation or implementation before projecting summary fields.

entries.failure: A read-only inherited-packet comparison found the x1 validation receipt but then assumed a separate manifests directory that does not exist in the source phase.
entries.recovery: Read the inherited validation directory inventory and use its x1-staged-manifest, x1-staged-privacy, and x1-staged-review contracts.
entries.recurrence_guard: Inventory the exact phase-local validation directory before assuming a manifest subdirectory layout.

entries.failure: The first x1 document-cap wrapper over-escaped its word-boundary expression and reported a visibly false maximum of zero words.
entries.recovery: Use a bounded UTF-8 whitespace-token count for the five x1 narrative documents and reject any document above the declared cap.
entries.recurrence_guard: Prefer a simple inspected whitespace-token count over nested shell and Python regex escaping for document-cap receipts.

entries.failure: The hand-computed x1 validation receipt predicted 84 manifest entries and 87 staged paths, while the exact index review observed 87 entries and 90 paths after the expanded Method Flow records.
entries.recovery: Regenerate the packet with every retained failure, derive final counts from the exact Git index, and update the receipt before rebuilding manifest hashes.
entries.recurrence_guard: Derive staged totals after Method Flow regeneration instead of projecting them from an earlier file inventory.

entries.failure: The first committed x1 ledger preserved two pass-labelled witnesses whose observed text still said Pending because append-only witness IDs were created before their recoveries completed.
entries.recovery: Preserve both historical rows, append corrected uniquely identified passing witnesses through the Method Flow runner, and classify the old rows as retained invalidated history in a stale-label receipt.
entries.recurrence_guard: Do not promote or persist a pass-labelled witness until its observed field contains the completed bounded result.

entries.failure: A read-only help probe guessed a repository-local Method Flow runner path that does not exist and exited before showing the command contract.
entries.recovery: Use the exact skill-owned runner path already declared by the x1 generator and request its help directly.
entries.recurrence_guard: Read the declared runner constant instead of guessing a repository-local executable path.

entries.failure: The first x1 repair test run expected exactly two witnesses per negative and failed because the append-only ledger correctly retained two additional correction witnesses: 42 observed versus 40 expected.
entries.recovery: Require one failed and one base passing witness per negative, then require exactly the two named correction witnesses and their bounded pass results separately.
entries.recurrence_guard: Method Flow tests must distinguish base witness pairs from additive correction witnesses.

entries.failure: The first repair receipt predicted 25 manifest entries and 28 staged paths, while the exact repair index contained 27 entries and 30 paths because two regenerated phase-index artifacts were omitted from the projection.
entries.recovery: Retain the mismatch, use the exact staged name list as the baseline, include this new Method Flow triplet, and rebuild the repair receipt and manifest at 30 entries plus three exclusions.
entries.recurrence_guard: Use the exact staged name list, not a projected generator-output delta, for lifecycle receipt totals.

entries.failed: The first x2 packet builder completed all twenty phase-local skill builds, then failed closed before aggregate evidence artifacts because it requested a nonexistent proposal evidence_class field.
entries.passing: The corrected builder used approval_class, retained all first-run skill initialization receipts, and completed the twenty-surface aggregate packet.
entries.recovery: Use the frozen approval_class field in the evidence ledger, preserve first-run skill initialization truth across retry, and rerun the bounded builder without awarding the failed attempt evidence credit.
entries.recurrence_guard: Inspect frozen proposal keys before projecting aggregate-ledger fields.

entries.failed: The second x2 builder passed the proposal schema correction and wrote aggregate evidence, then stopped before terminal artifacts because the wellbeing receipt referenced an undefined IDENTITY_BOUNDARY constant.
entries.passing: The corrected wellbeing receipt reused the frozen relational boundary and the packet builder reached its terminal Method Flow update.
entries.recovery: Use the phase's already-frozen relational BOUNDARY constant in the wellbeing receipt and rerun without crediting the incomplete attempt.
entries.recurrence_guard: Inspect phase-data exports before referencing a boundary constant from an aggregate builder.

entries.failed: The first combined x1 and x2 evidence suite raised a key error because one x1 environment assertion read the evolving x2 file-count receipt instead of the frozen x1 commit.
entries.passing: The corrected combined suite read the frozen x1 environment receipt and passed the original rotation assertions.
entries.recovery: Load the environment receipt through the existing x1 commit-pinned helper, leaving the x2 receipt free to use its successor schema.
entries.recurrence_guard: Every x1 invariant checked after x2 begins must use the x1 commit-pinned loader.

entries.failed: The first combined suite rejected structurally valid table row headers because the report generator used single-quoted scope attributes while the test required double quotes.
entries.passing: The normalized report exposed double-quoted row and column scope attributes and passed the structural accessibility test.
entries.recovery: Normalize generated row-header attributes to double quotes and retain the structural scope assertion.
entries.recurrence_guard: Keep generated accessibility-critical attributes in one canonical quoting style shared with structural tests.
